description: SDK for building WidBar taskbar widgets with WinUI 3 previews, flyouts, settings, and packaged AppExtension support.
releaseNotes:
Changes since 2.1.0

2.3.0
- The widget board, WidBar's full screen mosaic of widgets. A widget's tile shows its flyout by default, with nothing to do in the widget.
- New CreateTileContent and TileHeight, to give the board content of its own. IWidgetContext.IsBoardTile tells a tile from a taskbar copy.
- Board elements: list them in a BoardElements.json next to the project file, and the board offers each one as a tile of its own. IWidgetContext.BoardElement says which one a tile is.
- New IWidgetTileLifecycle, to resume and pause live work as a tile comes and goes.
- New IWidgetTileSettings: the gear on a tile can turn the tile into its own settings, in place.
- New IWidgetContext.SharedDataDirectory, for the data every copy of a widget shares. DataDirectory belongs to one copy, and a tile's is deleted when the tile is taken off the board.
- Names and descriptions in plugin.json and BoardElements.json can contain semicolons.
- Built against Windows App SDK 2.6.4.

2.2.3
- A widget added to a smart stack takes the stack's width from the start, instead of running past it until it is next moved.
- A widget removed while it is still starting no longer leaves its preview behind on the taskbar.

2.2.2
- New TaskbarButtonResources: the hover and pressed plate of the Windows 11 taskbar buttons, as resources to merge in App.xaml or as brushes for UI built in code (CreateBackgroundBrush, CreateBorderBrush).
- The whole-preview hover matches the taskbar in both themes and dims while pressed.

2.2.1
- A flyout always opens at the size WidBar gives it, also on a display at another scale.
- A flyout can no longer open twice.
- A flyout that ends up behind other windows comes back on top.
- Clicks and flyouts respond faster while your widget is busy.

2.2.0
- The flyout slides out of the taskbar like the Windows 11 quick settings, and stays smooth while your widget is busy.
- Large flyouts no longer pause or flash on their first open, and settings windows no longer flash black while resized.

2.1.2
- A widget no longer crashes when WidBar closes.
- The preview fills the whole height of the taskbar.
- New HighlightPreviewOnHover, for previews made of separate buttons.

2.1.1
- Switching Windows between light and dark no longer crashes widgets.
- Built against Windows App SDK 2.5.1.
title: WidBar SDK
